newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-GOVT PLANS LATTELEKOM STATE STAKE SALE-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-GOVT PLANS LATTELEKOM STATE STAKE SALE-REPORT.

text.p: Latvia is preparing to privatise the state-owned 51 percent stake in Lattelekom, in which Cable & Wireless and Telecom Finaland own the rest, Diena newspaper said on Tuesday.
The document which transfers the state stake to the Latvian Privatisation Agency was approved yesterday.

"The sale of the 51 percent state stake and the expected shortening of the Lattelekom monopoly period to 2003 from 2013 can be considered as a single process," Transport Minister Vilis Krishtopans was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
The first stage in the Lattelekom sell-off would be turning it into a joint stock company, Krishtopans added.
Latvia should not, however, hurry with selling its stake as Lattelekom's value may grow several times in line with the growth of the purchasing power of the population, he was quoted as adding.
